topic: Antonio Damasio & Antoine Bechara (1994, 1997) Iowa Gambling Task, Somatic Marker Hypothesis in Ventromedial Prefrontal Cortex, and Shiv (2005) Myopic Loss Aversion Paradox (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Baba Shiv, Antoine Bechara, and Antonio Damasio's 2005 Stanford-Iowa study demonstrating that vmPFC patients without somatic fear markers outperform healthy controls in a positive-expected-value investment game.
